title.zh: 卷270 列傳五十七 郝浴 杨素蕴 郭琇
title.en: Volume 270 Biographies 57: Hao Yu, Yang Suyun, Guo Xiu
title.raw: 卷270 列傳五十七 郝浴 杨素蕴 郭琇

sentences.zh: 列傳五十七

translations.literal: Biographies Fifty-Seven
translations.idiomatic: Biographies 57

sentences.zh: 郝浴子林楊素蘊郭琇

translations.literal: Hao Yu; his son Lin; Yang Suyun; Guo Xiu
translations.idiomatic: Hao Yu; his son Lin; Yang Suyun; and Guo Xiu

sentences.zh: 郝浴，字雪海，直隸定州人。

translations.literal: Hao Yu, courtesy name Xuehai, was a native of Dingzhou in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: Hao Yu, styled Xuehai, was from Dingzhou in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 少有志操，負氣節。

translations.literal: From youth he had lofty aspirations and integrity, and possessed strong moral character.
translations.idiomatic: Even as a young man he showed high purpose and integrity, and was known for his uncompromising sense of honor.

sentences.zh: 順治六年進士，授刑部主事。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Shunzhi he passed the jinshi examination and was appointed a principal clerk in the Ministry of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: He received his jinshi degree in the sixth year of Shunzhi and was appointed a principal clerk in the Ministry of Justice.

sentences.zh: 八年，改湖廣道御史，巡按四川。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was transferred to censor of the Huguang circuit and sent to inspect Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was made a censor of the Huguang circuit and dispatched to inspect Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 時張獻忠將孫可望、李定國等降明，為桂王將，據川南為寇，師討之，郡縣吏率軍前除授，恣為貪虐。

translations.literal: At the time generals of Zhang Xianzhong such as Sun Kewang and Li Dingguo had surrendered to the Ming and served as generals for the Prince of Gui, holding the southern Sichuan region as bandits; as imperial troops pursued them, county and prefectural officials appointed ahead of the army abused their power with greed and cruelty.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Sun Kewang, Li Dingguo, and other former generals of Zhang Xianzhong had submitted to the Ming and served the Prince of Gui, holding southern Sichuan as rebels. While imperial forces campaigned against them, county and prefectural officials appointed in advance of the army ran rampant with greed and abuse.

sentences.zh: 浴至，嚴約束，廉民間疾苦，將吏始斂跡。

translations.literal: When Hao Yu arrived, he imposed strict discipline, attended to the people's hardships, and only then did officers and officials restrain themselves.
translations.idiomatic: When Hao Yu arrived, he enforced strict discipline, looked into the people's suffering, and the military and civil officials finally checked their behavior.

sentences.zh: 九年，平西王吳三桂與固山額真李國翰分兵復成都、嘉定、敘州、重慶。

translations.literal: In the ninth year the Prince of Pingxi Wu Sangui and Gushan Ejen Li Guohan divided their forces to recover Chengdu, Jiading, Xuzhou, and Chongqing.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year the Prince of Pingxi, Wu Sangui, and the Gushan Ejen Li Guohan split their armies to retake Chengdu, Jiading, Xuzhou, and Chongqing.

sentences.zh: 已而兩路兵俱敗，三桂退駐綿州。

translations.literal: Soon both columns were defeated, and Wu Sangui withdrew and encamped at Mianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Before long both columns were defeated, and Wu Sangui fell back to Mianzhou.

sentences.zh: 浴在保寧監臨鄉試，可望將數万人薄城，浴飛檄邀三桂，激以大義，謂「不死於賊，必死於法」。

translations.literal: Hao Yu was at Baoning supervising the provincial examination when Sun Kewang led tens of thousands of men to press against the city; Hao Yu sent urgent dispatches summoning Wu Sangui, exhorting him with righteous duty, saying, "If you do not die at the hands of bandits, you will die by the law."
translations.idiomatic: Hao Yu was at Baoning overseeing the provincial examination when Sun Kewang approached the city with tens of thousands of men. Hao Yu sent urgent dispatches calling on Wu Sangui, rousing him with the demands of duty: "If you do not die at the hands of the rebels, you will die under the law."

sentences.zh: 踰月，三桂乃赴援，可望等引去。

translations.literal: After more than a month Wu Sangui finally came to the rescue, and Sun Kewang and the others withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: More than a month later Wu Sangui at last marched to relieve the city, and Sun Kewang and his forces withdrew.

sentences.zh: 浴在圍城中，上詔詢收川方略，疏言：「秦兵苦轉餉，川兵苦待哺，故必秦不助川而後秦可保；

translations.literal: While besieged in the city, the emperor issued an edict inquiring about strategies for recovering Sichuan; Hao Yu memorialized, saying, "Qin troops suffer from transporting provisions, and Sichuan troops suffer from waiting to be fed; therefore Qin must not assist Sichuan before Qin itself can be preserved;
translations.idiomatic: While still inside the besieged city, the emperor issued an edict asking how Sichuan might be recovered. Hao Yu memorialized: "Shaanxi troops are worn down by hauling supplies, and Sichuan troops are worn down by waiting to be fed. Shaanxi can be kept secure only if it does not keep propping up Sichuan;

sentences.zh: 川不冀秦助而後川可圖。

translations.literal: Sichuan must not expect Qin's assistance before Sichuan can be taken.
translations.idiomatic: and Sichuan can be taken only if it does not count on help from Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 成都地大且要，灌口一水，襟帶三十州縣。

translations.literal: Chengdu is vast and strategically vital; the single watercourse at the irrigation works commands thirty prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: Chengdu is broad in territory and vital in position; the Dujiangyan channel alone binds together thirty prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 若移兵成都，照籍屯田，開耕一年，可當秦運三年。

translations.literal: If troops were moved to Chengdu and garrison farming were conducted according to household registers, one year of cultivation could equal three years of provisions transport from Qin.
translations.idiomatic: If troops were shifted to Chengdu and garrison farms were opened according to household registers, one year of cultivation would supply what three years of transport from Shaanxi could provide.

sentences.zh: 所難者牛種，倘令土司出牛，撫臣與立券，豐年還其值，當無不聽命。

translations.literal: The difficulty lies in cattle and seed; if native chiefs were ordered to supply cattle and the provincial governor established written contracts with them, repaying their value in good harvest years, they would surely obey.
translations.idiomatic: The hard part is cattle and seed. If native chiefs were required to supply oxen and the governor drew up contracts with them, repaying their value in good harvest years, they would surely comply.

sentences.zh: 嘉定據上游，饒茶、鹽，令暫易穀種，則牛、種俱不難辦也。

translations.literal: Jiading lies upstream and is rich in tea and salt; if grain seed were temporarily exchanged for these, then both cattle and seed would not be hard to procure.
translations.idiomatic: Jiading sits upstream and is rich in tea and salt. If grain seed were temporarily traded for those goods, both cattle and seed would become easy to obtain.

sentences.zh: 臣故謂開屯便。

translations.literal: I therefore maintain that opening garrison farms is advantageous.
translations.idiomatic: That is why I say opening garrison farms is the better course.

sentences.zh: 川所患者滇寇也，滇寇所恃，不過皮兜、布鎧、鳥銃、濩刀，善於騰山踰嶺。

translations.literal: What afflicts Sichuan is the bandits from Yunnan; what the Yunnan bandits rely on are nothing more than leather helmets, cloth armor, muskets, and curved blades, and they are skilled at scaling mountains and crossing ridges.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan's trouble is the Yunnan rebels. They rely on nothing more than leather helmets, cloth armor, muskets, and curved blades, and they excel at scaling mountains and crossing ridges.

sentences.zh: 蜀中土官土兵，其技尤嫻於此。

translations.literal: The native officials and native troops in Shu are even more adept at these skills.
translations.idiomatic: The native officials and native troops of Shu are even more skilled in such fighting.

sentences.zh: 若拔其精銳為前茅，以滿洲驍騎為後勁，疾雷迅霆，賊必鳥獸散。

translations.literal: If their elite forces were selected as vanguard while Manchu cavalry formed the rear, striking like thunder and lightning, the bandits would surely scatter like birds and beasts.
translations.idiomatic: If their best fighters were chosen as the vanguard and Manchu cavalry formed the rear, striking like thunder, the rebels would scatter like frightened birds and beasts.

sentences.zh: 臣故謂用土兵便。

translations.literal: I therefore maintain that using native troops is advantageous.
translations.idiomatic: That is why I say employing native troops is the better course.

sentences.zh: 」上以其言可採，下部議。

translations.literal: " The emperor found his words worth adopting and ordered the ministries to deliberate.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor judged his advice worth adopting and referred it to the ministries for deliberation.

sentences.zh: 部議謂戰守事當聽三桂主之，遂報寢。

translations.literal: The ministries decided that offensive and defensive matters should be left to Wu Sangui's discretion, and the memorial was subsequently shelved.
translations.idiomatic: The ministries ruled that offensive and defensive affairs should be left to Wu Sangui, and the proposal was shelved.

sentences.zh: 浴又言：「土賊投誠，給劄授官，恣行劫掠為民害。

translations.literal: Hao Yu also said, "Native bandits who surrendered were given certificates and official appointments, yet freely plundered and harmed the people.
translations.idiomatic: Hao Yu also wrote: "Native rebels who submit are given certificates and official rank, then freely plunder and prey on the people.

sentences.zh: 請嗣後原歸伍者歸伍，原為民者，令有司造冊編丁，免牛租，除雜派，就熟地開徵，俾有定額。

translations.literal: I request that hereafter those originally in military service return to the ranks, and those originally commoners be registered by local officials, exempted from cattle rents and miscellaneous levies, with taxes collected on cultivated land so there will be fixed quotas.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that hereafter those who originally belonged in the ranks be returned to the ranks, and those who were originally commoners be registered by local officials, exempted from cattle rents and miscellaneous levies, and taxed on cultivated land according to fixed quotas.

sentences.zh: 」疏議行。

translations.literal: " The memorial was approved for implementation.
translations.idiomatic: " The memorial was approved and put into effect.

sentences.zh: 三桂入四川，浸驕橫，部下多不法，憚浴嚴正，輒禁止沿路塘報。

translations.literal: When Wu Sangui entered Sichuan he grew increasingly arrogant and overbearing; many of his subordinates acted unlawfully, and fearing Hao Yu's strict integrity, they repeatedly blocked relay reports along the route.
translations.idiomatic: After Wu Sangui entered Sichuan he grew ever more arrogant. Many of his subordinates broke the law, and because they feared Hao Yu's strict integrity they repeatedly blocked courier reports along the route.

sentences.zh: 浴上言：「臣忝司朝廷耳目，而壅閼若此，安用臣為？

translations.literal: Hao Yu memorialized the throne, saying, "I am charged with serving as the court's eyes and ears, yet if obstruction is allowed like this, what use am I?
translations.idiomatic: Hao Yu memorialized: "I am supposed to serve as the court's eyes and ears. If obstruction like this is permitted, what use is there in keeping me?

sentences.zh: 」及保寧圍解，頒賞將士，三桂以冠服與浴，浴不受。

translations.literal: " After the siege of Baoning was lifted, rewards were distributed to officers and soldiers; Wu Sangui gave Hao Yu robes and a cap, which Hao Yu refused to accept.
translations.idiomatic: " After the siege of Baoning was lifted, rewards were distributed to the officers and soldiers. Wu Sangui offered Hao Yu robes and a cap, but Hao Yu refused them.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「平賊乃平西王責。

translations.literal: His memorial stated, "Suppressing bandits is the responsibility of the Prince of Pingxi.
translations.idiomatic: In his memorial he wrote: "Suppressing the rebels is the Prince of Pingxi's duty.

sentences.zh: 臣司風憲，不預軍事，而以臣預賞，非黨臣則忌臣也。

translations.literal: I oversee censorial discipline and do not participate in military affairs; to include me in the reward is either to treat me as an ally or to show hostility toward me.
translations.idiomatic: I oversee censorial discipline and take no part in military affairs. To include me in the reward is either to treat me as a partisan or to show hostility toward me.

sentences.zh: 」因陳三桂擁兵觀望狀，三桂深銜之。

translations.literal: " He thereupon described Wu Sangui's situation of holding troops and watching from the sidelines, and Wu Sangui deeply resented him.
translations.idiomatic: " He went on to describe Wu Sangui's habit of holding his army back and waiting to see which way things would turn, and Wu Sangui deeply resented him.

sentences.zh: 浴劾永寧總兵柏永馥臨陣退縮，廣元副將胡一鵬驕悍不法，並命奪官逮治。

translations.literal: Hao Yu impeached Yongning garrison commander Bai Yongfu for shrinking back in battle and Guangyuan deputy commander Hu Yipeng for arrogant and unlawful behavior, ordering that both be stripped of rank and arrested for punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Hao Yu impeached Yongning garrison commander Bai Yongfu for shrinking back in battle and Guangyuan deputy commander Hu Yipeng for arrogant and unlawful conduct, and ordered both stripped of rank and arrested for punishment.

sentences.zh: 降將董顯忠等以副將銜題授司道，恣睢虐民，浴复疏劾，改原職。

translations.literal: Surrendered generals Dong Xianzhong and others were appointed to circuit-intendant rank as deputy commanders and tyrannized the people; Hao Yu again memorialized to impeach them and they were reverted to their original ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Surrendered generals such as Dong Xianzhong had been nominated to circuit-intendant posts with the rank of deputy commander and tyrannized the people. Hao Yu memorialized again to impeach them, and they were reduced to their original ranks.

sentences.zh: 三桂嗾顯忠等入京陳辨，浴坐鐫秩去。

translations.literal: Wu Sangui incited Dong Xianzhong and the others to go to the capital to plead their case, and Hao Yu was demoted and dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Sangui incited Dong Xianzhong and the others to go to the capital and plead their case, and Hao Yu was demoted and removed from office.

sentences.zh: 十一年，大學士馮銓、成克鞏、呂宮等交章薦浴，三桂乃摭浴保寧奏捷疏有「親冒矢石」語，指為冒功，論劾，部議當坐死，上命寬之，流徙奉天。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year Grand Secretaries Feng Quan, Cheng Kegong, Lu Gong, and others jointly recommended Hao Yu; Wu Sangui then seized upon Hao Yu's victory memorial from Baoning containing the phrase "personally braved arrows and stones" and accused him of claiming undeserved merit; after deliberation the ministries recommended death as the penalty, but the emperor ordered leniency and exiled him to Fengtian.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year Grand Secretaries Feng Quan, Cheng Kegong, Lu Gong, and others jointly recommended Hao Yu. Wu Sangui then seized on a phrase in Hao Yu's Baoning victory memorial—"personally braved arrows and stones"—and accused him of claiming credit he did not deserve. After deliberation the ministries recommended the death penalty, but the emperor ordered leniency and exiled him to Fengtian.

sentences.zh: 大學士馮銓、成克鞏、呂宮皆以薦浴罣吏議。

translations.literal: Grand Secretaries Feng Quan, Cheng Kegong, and Lu Gong were all implicated in censorial proceedings for recommending Hao Yu.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretaries Feng Quan, Cheng Kegong, and Lu Gong were all drawn into censorial proceedings for having recommended Hao Yu.

sentences.zh: 浴至戍所，益潛心義理之學，嗜孟子及二程遺書，以「致知格物」顏其廬，刻苦厲志。

translations.literal: At his place of exile Hao Yu devoted himself even more deeply to the study of moral principle, fond of Mencius and the surviving writings of the Cheng brothers, and titled his dwelling "Investigating Things to Extend Knowledge"; he cultivated himself with rigor and resolve.
translations.idiomatic: At his place of exile Hao Yu devoted himself even more deeply to moral philosophy, reading Mencius and the surviving works of the Cheng brothers. He named his dwelling "Investigating Things to Extend Knowledge" and disciplined himself with stern resolve.

sentences.zh: 康熙十年，聖祖幸奉天，浴迎謁道左，具陳始末，上為動容，慰勞良久。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Kangxi the Sage Ancestor visited Fengtian; Hao Yu welcomed and paid respects on the roadside, fully recounting the sequence of events; the emperor was moved and offered extended consolation.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year of Kangxi the Sage Ancestor visited Fengtian. Hao Yu greeted him by the roadside and recounted the whole affair from beginning to end. The emperor was moved and comforted him at length.

sentences.zh: 十二年，三桂反，尚書王熙、給事中劉沛先薦浴，為部議所格。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, when Wu Sangui rebelled, Minister Wang Xi and petitioning official Liu Pei first recommended Hao Yu, but the recommendation was blocked by the ministries' deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, when Wu Sangui rebelled, Minister Wang Xi and petitioning official Liu Pei were the first to recommend Hao Yu, but the ministries blocked the recommendation.

sentences.zh: 十四年，侍郎魏象樞复疏言：「浴血性過人，才守學識，臣皆愧不及。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year Vice Minister Wei Xiangshu again memorialized, saying, "Hao Yu's native temperament surpasses ordinary men, and in talent, integrity, and learning I am all ashamed to fall short of him.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year Vice Minister Wei Xiangshu memorialized again: "Hao Yu's native temperament surpasses that of ordinary men. In talent, integrity, and learning I am ashamed to say I fall short of him.

sentences.zh: 使在西蜀操尺寸之權，豈肯如羅森輩俯首從逆？

translations.literal: Had he held even slight authority in western Shu, would he have bowed his head and followed the rebels like Luo Sen and his kind?
translations.idiomatic: If he had held even the smallest measure of authority in western Shu, would he have bowed his head and followed the rebels like Luo Sen and his kind?

sentences.zh: 臣子立朝，各有本末。

translations.literal: When ministers serve at court, each has his own record from beginning to end.
translations.idiomatic: Every official who serves at court has his own record from beginning to end.

sentences.zh: 當日參浴者三桂也，使三桂始終恭順，方且任以腹心。

translations.literal: The one who impeached Hao Yu back then was Wu Sangui; had Wu Sangui remained consistently obedient, he would surely have been entrusted as a trusted confidant.
translations.idiomatic: The man who impeached Hao Yu back then was Wu Sangui. Had Wu Sangui remained consistently loyal, he would still have been trusted as a confidant.

sentences.zh: 浴一書生耳，即老死徙所，誰復問之？

translations.literal: Hao Yu was but a scholar; even if he died of old age in exile, who would inquire after him?
translations.idiomatic: Hao Yu was only a scholar. Even if he died of old age in exile, who would have cared?

sentences.zh: 今三桂叛矣，天下無不恨三桂，即無不憐浴。

translations.literal: Now Wu Sangui has rebelled; there is not a person in the realm who does not hate Wu Sangui, and not one who does not pity Hao Yu.
translations.idiomatic: Now Wu Sangui has rebelled. There is no one under heaven who does not hate Wu Sangui, and no one who does not pity Hao Yu.

sentences.zh: 浴當三桂身居王爵，手握兵柄，不畏威，不附勢，致為所仇。

translations.literal: When Wu Sangui held princely rank and commanded armies, Hao Yu did not fear his might nor attach himself to his power, and thus became the object of his enmity.
translations.idiomatic: When Wu Sangui held princely rank and commanded armies, Hao Yu neither feared his power nor attached himself to his influence, and for that he became Wu Sangui's enemy.

sentences.zh: 三桂之所仇，正國家之所取，何忍棄之？

translations.literal: What Wu Sangui hated is precisely what the state should value — how can we bear to abandon him?
translations.idiomatic: What Wu Sangui hated is precisely what the state should value. How can we bear to cast him aside?

sentences.zh: 」上乃召浴還，复授湖廣道御史。

translations.literal: " The emperor thereupon summoned Hao Yu back and restored him as censor of the Huguang circuit.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor then summoned Hao Yu back and restored him as censor of the Huguang circuit.

sentences.zh: 時陝西提督王輔臣叛應三桂，浴疏言：「大兵進剿平涼，宜於西安、潼關用重兵屯駐，以待策應。

translations.literal: At that time Shaanxi military commissioner Wang Fuchen rebelled in support of Wu Sangui; Hao Yu memorialized, saying, "When the main army advances to suppress Pingliang, heavy forces should be garrisoned at Xi'an and Tongguan to await coordinated response.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Shaanxi military commissioner Wang Fuchen rebelled in support of Wu Sangui. Hao Yu memorialized: "When the main army advances against Pingliang, heavy forces should be stationed at Xi'an and Tongguan to await coordinated action.

sentences.zh: 用鄖陽之兵攻興安，調河南之兵入武關，直取漢中，逆賊計日可擒。

translations.literal: Use troops from Xunyang to attack Xing'an, and transfer Henan troops through Wuguan to strike directly at Hanzhong; the rebel can be captured within days.
translations.idiomatic: Use the troops from Xunyang to attack Xing'an, and move Henan troops through Wuguan to strike directly at Hanzhong. The rebel can be taken within days.

sentences.zh: 」上然之，下其疏諸帥。

translations.literal: " The emperor agreed and distributed his memorial to the commanders.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor approved and circulated the memorial to the field commanders.

sentences.zh: 復請禁苛徵，恤民困，止督、撫、提、鎮坐​​名題補之例。

translations.literal: He also requested prohibiting onerous levies, relieving the people's distress, and stopping the practice of governors, governors-general, commanders, and garrison chiefs nominally filling vacancies without actual appointment.
translations.idiomatic: He also asked that onerous levies be forbidden, the people's hardship relieved, and the practice stopped whereby governors-general, governors, commanders, and garrison chiefs merely filled vacancies in name without making real appointments.

sentences.zh: 章十數上，皆中時弊。

translations.literal: He submitted more than ten such memorials, all striking at the evils of the time.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted more than ten such memorials, each hitting the abuses of the day.

sentences.zh: 十六年，命巡視兩淮鹽政，嚴剔宿蠹，增課六十餘萬。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he was ordered to inspect the salt administration of the two Huai circuits, strictly eliminating longstanding corruption and increasing revenue by more than six hundred thousand taels.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he was ordered to inspect the salt administration of the two Huai circuits. He rigorously cut out longstanding corruption and increased revenue by more than six hundred thousand taels.

sentences.zh: 淮、揚大饑，發倉米賑救，全活甚眾。

translations.literal: During a great famine in Huai and Yangzhou, he distributed granary grain for relief and saved a great many lives.
translations.idiomatic: When Huai and Yangzhou suffered a great famine, he opened the granaries and distributed grain for relief, saving a great many lives.

sentences.zh: 十七年，擢左僉都御史，遷左副都御史。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he was promoted to Left Assistant Censor-in-Chief, then transferred to Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he was promoted to Left Assistant Censor-in-Chief and then transferred to Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 十九年，授廣西巡撫。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year he was appointed Governor of Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year he was appointed governor of Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 廣西新經喪亂，民生凋瘵，浴專意撫綏，疏陳調劑四策，請裁兵、汰馬、防要害、簡精銳；

translations.literal: Guangxi had recently suffered turmoil and the people's livelihood was devastated; Hao Yu focused on pacification and relief, memorializing four measures for readjustment and requesting troop reductions, elimination of excess horses, defense of critical points, and selection of elite forces;
translations.idiomatic: Guangxi had only recently been ravaged by war and the people's livelihood was in ruins. Hao Yu devoted himself to pacification and relief, memorializing four measures for readjustment: reduce troops, cut excess horses, defend critical points, and select elite fighters;

sentences.zh: 復請停鼓鑄，改米徵銀，复南寧、太平、思恩諸府縣行鹽舊制：上輒報可。

translations.literal: He also requested halting coinage, converting grain levies to silver, and restoring the old salt monopoly in Nanning, Taiping, Si'en, and other prefectures and counties; the emperor invariably approved.
translations.idiomatic: he also asked that coinage be halted, grain levies converted to silver payments, and the old salt monopoly restored in Nanning, Taiping, Si'en, and other prefectures and counties. The emperor approved each request.

sentences.zh: 時南疆底定，滿洲兵撤還京師。

translations.literal: At that time the southern frontier had been pacified and Manchu troops were withdrawn to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: By then the southern frontier had been pacified and the Manchu troops were withdrawn to the capital.

sentences.zh: 浴疏言撫標兵不宜裁減，下部議，留其半。

translations.literal: Hao Yu memorialized that the governor's banner troops should not be reduced; after deliberation by the ministries, half were retained.
translations.idiomatic: Hao Yu memorialized that the governor's banner troops should not be cut. After deliberation the ministries kept half of them.

sentences.zh: 又請為死事巡撫馬雄鎮、傅弘烈建祠桂林，知府劉浩、知縣周岱生為孫延齡所戕，疏請予卹。

translations.literal: He also requested building shrines in Guilin for fallen governors Ma Xiongzhen and Fu Honglie, and posthumous honors for prefect Liu Hao and magistrate Zhou Daisheng, killed by Sun Yanling.
translations.idiomatic: He also asked that shrines be built in Guilin for the fallen governors Ma Xiongzhen and Fu Honglie, and that posthumous honors be granted to Prefect Liu Hao and Magistrate Zhou Daisheng, who had been killed by Sun Yanling.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，卒官。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year he died in office.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year he died in office.

sentences.zh: 喪歸，士民泣送者數千里不絕。

translations.literal: When his coffin returned home, scholars and common people wept and escorted him for thousands of li without interruption.
translations.idiomatic: When his coffin returned home, scholars and common people wept and escorted it for thousands of li without a break.

sentences.zh: 初，傅弘烈以軍事急，移庫金七萬有奇、米七千餘石供餉，浴請以庫項扣抵。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Fu Honglie urgently needed funds for military operations, he transferred more than seventy thousand taels from the treasury and over seven thousand shi of grain for provisions; Hao Yu requested deducting this from treasury accounts.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when military affairs were urgent, Fu Honglie had transferred more than seventy thousand taels from the treasury and over seven thousand shi of grain for provisions. Hao Yu asked that this be deducted from treasury accounts.

sentences.zh: 及卒，布政使崔維雅署巡撫，劾浴侵欺，命郎中蘇赫、陳光祖往按，如維雅言。

translations.literal: After Hao Yu died, Financial Commissioner Cui Weiya acting as governor impeached Hao Yu for embezzlement and fraud; the emperor dispatched Director Lang Suhe and Chen Guangzu to investigate, and their findings matched Cui Weiya's accusations.
translations.idiomatic: After Hao Yu died, Financial Commissioner Cui Weiya, acting as governor, impeached him for embezzlement and fraud. The emperor sent Director Lang Suhe and Chen Guangzu to investigate, and their findings matched Cui Weiya's charges.

sentences.zh: 部議奪官追償。

translations.literal: The ministries recommended stripping his rank and demanding restitution.
translations.idiomatic: The ministries recommended stripping his rank and demanding restitution.

sentences.zh: 上知浴廉，諭所動錢糧非入己，從寬免追。

translations.literal: The emperor knew Hao Yu was incorruptible and instructed that the impounded funds and grain had not entered his personal possession; restitution was waived with leniency.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor knew Hao Yu was incorruptible and ruled that the funds and grain in question had not entered his personal possession. Restitution was waived with leniency.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，子林訟父冤，復原官，賜祭葬。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year his son Lin sued on his father's behalf to redress the injustice; Hao Yu's original rank was restored and imperial sacrifices and burial honors were granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year his son Lin petitioned to clear his father's name. Hao Yu's original rank was restored and imperial sacrifices and burial honors were granted.

sentences.zh: 林，字中美。

translations.literal: Lin, courtesy name Zhongmei.
translations.idiomatic: Lin, styled Zhongmei.

sentences.zh: 康熙二十一年進士，授中書科中書，歷吏部郎中，亦以廉正稱。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year of Kangxi he passed the jinshi examination and was appointed a secretary in the Secretariat, then served through the rank of Director in the Ministry of Personnel, also famed for incorruptibility and integrity.
translations.idiomatic: He received his jinshi degree in the twenty-first year of Kangxi and was appointed a secretary in the Secretariat. He rose to serve as a director in the Ministry of Personnel and was likewise known for integrity.

sentences.zh: 累遷禮部侍郎，加尚書銜。

translations.literal: He was promoted successively to Vice Minister of Rites, with the nominal rank of Minister.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted in stages to Vice Minister of Rites, with the nominal rank of minister.

sentences.zh: 致仕，卒。

translations.literal: He retired from office and died.
translations.idiomatic: He retired from office and later died.

sentences.zh: 楊素蘊，字筠湄，陝西宜君人。

translations.literal: Yang Suyun, courtesy name Junmei, was a native of Yijun in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Suyun, styled Junmei, was from Yijun in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 順治九年進士，授直隸東明知縣。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Shunzhi he passed the jinshi examination and was appointed magistrate of Dongming in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: He received his jinshi degree in the ninth year of Shunzhi and was appointed magistrate of Dongming in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 東明當河決後，官舍城垣悉敗，民居殆盡，遺民依丘阜，僅數十家。

translations.literal: Dongming lay in the aftermath of a river breach; government buildings and city walls were entirely ruined, civilian dwellings nearly all gone, and surviving residents clung to hillocks — barely several dozen households.
translations.idiomatic: Dongming lay in the aftermath of a river breach. Government buildings and city walls were entirely ruined, civilian dwellings were nearly all gone, and the survivors clung to hillocks—barely several dozen households remained.

sentences.zh: 素蘊至，為繕城郭，招集流亡，三年戶增至萬餘。

translations.literal: When Yang Suyun arrived he repaired the walls and defenses, gathered the displaced populace, and within three years households increased to more than ten thousand.
translations.idiomatic: When Yang Suyun arrived he repaired the walls and defenses, gathered the displaced population, and within three years households had grown to more than ten thousand.

sentences.zh: 山東群盜任鳳亭等剽掠旁郡，擾及畿南。

translations.literal: Bandits in Shandong such as Ren Fengting plundered neighboring prefectures and harassed the southern capital region.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits in Shandong such as Ren Fengting plundered neighboring prefectures and even harassed the region south of the capital.

sentences.zh: 素蘊設計降其渠，散其脅從。

translations.literal: Yang Suyun devised a plan to induce their leaders to surrender and disperse their compelled followers.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Suyun devised a plan to induce their leaders to surrender and disperse their compelled followers.

sentences.zh: 十七年，舉卓異，行取，授四川道御史。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he was commended as outstanding, selected for capital office, and appointed censor of the Sichuan circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he was commended as outstanding, selected for service in the capital, and appointed censor of the Sichuan circuit.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「臣言官也，宜以言為事。

translations.literal: He memorialized, saying, "I am a remonstrating official and ought to make remonstrance my business.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "I am a remonstrating official, and remonstrance ought to be my business.

sentences.zh: 然今天下所患，正在議論多而成功少。

translations.literal: Yet what the realm suffers from today is precisely too much discussion and too little accomplishment.
translations.idiomatic: Yet what the realm suffers from today is too much talk and too little accomplishment.

sentences.zh: 國家建官分職，各有所事。

translations.literal: The state establishes offices with divided duties, each with its own charge.
translations.idiomatic: The state establishes offices with divided duties, each with its own charge.

sentences.zh: 誠使司舉劾，籌財用，任封疆，理刑獄，各舉其職，則平天下無餘事。

translations.literal: If censors truly performed impeachment, finance officers truly managed revenues, frontier governors truly bore territorial responsibility, and judicial officers truly handled punishments — each fulfilling his office — then governing the realm would leave no remaining task.
translations.idiomatic: If censors truly performed impeachment, finance officers truly managed revenues, frontier governors truly bore territorial responsibility, and judicial officers truly handled punishments—each fulfilling his office—then governing the realm would leave nothing undone.

sentences.zh: 更原皇上推誠御物，肅大閒，寬小眚，俾人人得展其才，尤端本澄源之要也。

translations.literal: I further pray that Your Majesty govern with sincerity toward all, maintain great propriety while pardoning minor faults, so that every man may fully deploy his talents — this above all is the essential for setting the root right and clearing the source.
translations.idiomatic: I further pray that Your Majesty govern with sincerity toward all, uphold great propriety while pardoning minor faults, so that every man may fully deploy his talents. That above all is the essential for setting the root right and clearing the source.

sentences.zh: 時吳三桂鎮雲南，郡縣吏得自闢署，謂之「西選」。

translations.literal: At that time Wu Sangui garrisoned Yunnan; prefectural and county officials could appoint their own subordinates — this was called "western selection."
translations.idiomatic: At that time Wu Sangui held Yunnan. Prefectural and county officials could appoint their own subordinates—a practice known as "western selection."

sentences.zh: 漸乃題用朝臣，無復顧忌。

translations.literal: Gradually he began nominating court ministers for appointment, no longer showing any restraint.
translations.idiomatic: Gradually he began nominating court ministers for appointment, no longer showing any restraint.

sentences.zh: 素蘊疏言：「三桂以上湖南道胡允等十員題補雲南各道，並有奉差部員在內，深足駭異。

translations.literal: Yang Suyun memorialized, saying, "Wu Sangui has nominated ten officials including Hu Yun of the Hunan circuit to fill various Yunnan circuit posts, among them officials dispatched from the ministries — this is deeply shocking.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Suyun memorialized: "Wu Sangui has nominated ten officials, including Hu Yun of the Hunan circuit, to fill various Yunnan circuit posts, among them officials dispatched from the ministries. This is deeply shocking.

sentences.zh: 爵祿者人主之大柄，綱紀者朝廷之大防，柄不可移，防不可潰。

translations.literal: Titles and stipends are the sovereign's supreme prerogative; institutional discipline is the court's paramount safeguard — the prerogative cannot be shifted, nor the safeguard breached.
translations.idiomatic: Titles and stipends are the sovereign's supreme prerogative; institutional discipline is the court's paramount safeguard. The prerogative cannot be shifted, nor the safeguard breached.

sentences.zh: 前此經略用人，特命二部不得掣肘，亦惟以軍前效用及所轄五省各官酌量題請，從未聞敢以他行省及現任京官坐缺定銜者也。

translations.literal: Previously when the frontier commissioner appointed personnel, the special order was that the two ministries must not obstruct; this applied only to frontline effectiveness and to officials within the five provinces under his jurisdiction who were nominated with due consideration — never before had anyone dared to fill vacant posts by assigning officials from other provinces or current capital officials to fixed ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, when the frontier commissioner appointed personnel, the special order was that the two ministries must not obstruct him. That applied only to men who had proved effective at the front and to officials within the five provinces under his jurisdiction, nominated with due consideration. Never before had anyone dared to fill vacant posts by assigning officials from other provinces or current capital officials to fixed ranks.

sentences.zh: 且疏稱求於滇省既苦索駿無從，求於遠方又恐叱馭不速，則湖南、四川距雲南猶近，若京師、山東、江南相去萬里，不知其所謂遠者更在何方？

translations.literal: Moreover the memorial states that searching within Yunnan province they found no suitable talent, and fearing delay if seeking from afar — yet Hunan and Sichuan are still near Yunnan; if the capital, Shandong, and Jiangnan lie ten thousand li distant, where could "farther" possibly lie?
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the memorial says that within Yunnan province no suitable men could be found, and that seeking from afar would risk delay. Yet Hunan and Sichuan are still near Yunnan. If the capital, Shandong, and Jiangnan lie ten thousand li away, where could "farther" possibly be?

sentences.zh: 皇上特假便宜，不過許其就近調補。

translations.literal: Your Majesty granted special discretionary authority — this permitted only nearby transfer and reassignment.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty granted special discretionary authority only to permit nearby transfer and reassignment.

sentences.zh: 若盡天下之官，不分內外，不論遠近，皆可擇而取之，何如歸吏部銓授，尤為名正言順。

translations.literal: If officials throughout the realm, regardless of inner or outer appointment, regardless of distance, may all be selected at will, would it not be more legitimate to return appointment to the Ministry of Personnel?
translations.idiomatic: If officials throughout the realm, regardless of inner or outer appointment and regardless of distance, may all be selected at will, would it not be more legitimate to return appointment to the Ministry of Personnel?

sentences.zh: 縱或云、貴新經開闢，料理乏人，諸臣才品為籓臣所素知，亦宜請旨令吏部簽補；

translations.literal: Even if one says Yunnan and Guizhou have newly been opened and lack personnel to administer them, and the officials' talents are well known to the frontier lord, they should still request an edict for the Ministry of Personnel to assign and confirm appointments;
translations.idiomatic: Even if one says Yunnan and Guizhou have only recently been opened and lack men to administer them, and that the frontier lord already knows these officials' talents and character, he should still request an edict for the Ministry of Personnel to assign and confirm appointments;

sentences.zh: 乃徑行擬用，不亦輕名器而褻國體乎？

translations.literal: To proceed directly with proposed appointments — does this not lightly treat official titles and profane the dignity of the state?
translations.idiomatic: To proceed directly with proposed appointments—is that not to treat official titles lightly and profane the dignity of the state?

sentences.zh: 人臣忠邪之分，起於一念之敬肆。

translations.literal: The division between loyal and treacherous ministers begins with a single thought of reverence or insolence.
translations.idiomatic: The line between loyal and treacherous ministers begins with a single thought of reverence or insolence.

sentences.zh: 籓臣易攵歷有年，應知大體。

translations.literal: The frontier lord Wu has held his position for many years and ought to understand the larger principles.
translations.idiomatic: The frontier lord Wu Sangui has held his post for many years and ought to understand what propriety requires.

sentences.zh: 此舉為封疆計，未必別有深心，然防微杜漸，當慎於幾先。

translations.literal: This measure is for the sake of the frontier and need not imply any deeper intent, yet to guard against the subtle and stop the gradual, one must be cautious at the very first sign.
translations.idiomatic: This act may have been intended for the frontier's sake and need not imply any deeper design, yet to guard against small beginnings and stop trouble before it spreads, one must be cautious at the first sign.

sentences.zh: 祈申飭籓臣，嗣後惟力圖進取，加意撫綏，一切威福大權，俱宜禀自朝廷，則君恩臣誼兩盡其善。

translations.literal: I pray that the frontier lord be sternly admonished: hereafter let him strive only for advance and conquest and give special care to pacification; all great powers of reward and punishment should be reported to and received from the court — then sovereign grace and ministerial duty will both be fully fulfilled.
translations.idiomatic: I pray that the frontier lord be sternly admonished: hereafter let him devote himself to advance and conquest and give special care to pacification, and let all great powers of reward and punishment be reported to and received from the court. Then sovereign grace and ministerial duty will both be fully honored.

sentences.zh: 」疏下部。

translations.literal: " The memorial was sent to the ministries.
translations.idiomatic: " The memorial was referred to the ministries.

sentences.zh: 十八年，聖祖即位，輔臣柄政，出素蘊為川北道。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year the Sage Ancestor ascended the throne; the assisting ministers held power and transferred Yang Suyun out to the Chuanbei circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year the Sage Ancestor ascended the throne. The assisting ministers held power and transferred Yang Suyun out to the Chuanbei circuit.

sentences.zh: 三桂見素蘊前奏，惡之，具疏辨，並摘「防微杜漸」語，謂意含隱射，語伏危機。

translations.literal: Wu Sangui, seeing Yang Suyun's earlier memorial, hated him and submitted a detailed rebuttal, seizing on the phrase "guard against the subtle and stop the gradual" and claiming the meaning contained hidden insinuation and concealed words of crisis.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Sangui, seeing Yang Suyun's earlier memorial, took offense and submitted a detailed rebuttal. He seized on the phrase "guard against small beginnings and stop trouble before it spreads" and claimed it carried hidden insinuations and veiled threats.

sentences.zh: 詔責素蘊回奏，素蘊言：「防微杜漸，古今通義。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Yang Suyun to reply; Yang Suyun said, "To guard against the subtle and stop the gradual is a universal principle from ancient times to the present.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Yang Suyun to reply. Yang Suyun wrote: "To guard against small beginnings and stop trouble before it spreads is a universal principle from ancient times to the present.

sentences.zh: 臣但期籓臣每事盡善，為聖世純臣，非有他也。

translations.literal: I only hope the frontier lord will do everything well and become a pure minister of this sage age — I have no other intent.
translations.idiomatic: I only hoped the frontier lord would do everything well and become a loyal minister of this sage age. I had no other intent.

sentences.zh: 」下部議，坐素蘊巧飾，當降調，罷歸。

translations.literal: " The memorial was sent to the ministries for deliberation; Yang Suyun was judged guilty of artful evasion, recommended for demotion and transfer, and dismissed to return home.
translations.idiomatic: " The memorial was referred to the ministries. Yang Suyun was judged guilty of artful evasion, recommended for demotion, and dismissed to return home.

sentences.zh: 居十年，三桂反。

translations.literal: After ten years at home, Wu Sangui rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: Ten years later Wu Sangui rebelled.

sentences.zh: 尚書郝惟訥、冀如錫，侍郎楊永寧交章請起用，惟訥詞尤切，略言：「素蘊首劾三桂，雲當防微杜漸。

translations.literal: Ministers Hao Weina and Ji Ruxi and Vice Minister Yang Yongning jointly memorialized requesting his reappointment; Weina's words were especially urgent, stating in summary, "Yang Suyun was the first to impeach Wu Sangui, saying one must guard against the subtle and stop the gradual.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers Hao Weina and Ji Ruxi and Vice Minister Yang Yongning jointly memorialized asking that he be reappointed. Weina's language was especially urgent: "Yang Suyun was the first to impeach Wu Sangui, warning that one must guard against small beginnings and stop trouble before it spreads.

sentences.zh: 在當日反狀未形，似屬杞憂。

translations.literal: At the time the signs of rebellion had not yet appeared, and it seemed mere groundless worry.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the signs of rebellion had not yet appeared, and it seemed like groundless worry.

sentences.zh: 由今觀之，則素蘊先見甚明，且為國直陳，奮不自顧，其剛腸正氣，實有大過人者！

translations.literal: Viewed from today, Yang Suyun's foresight was very clear; moreover he spoke straightly for the state and strove without regard for himself — his upright spirit and righteous force truly surpassed ordinary men!
translations.idiomatic: Seen from today, Yang Suyun's foresight was remarkably clear. He spoke plainly for the state and strove without regard for himself. His upright spirit truly surpassed that of ordinary men!

sentences.zh: 亟宜優錄。

translations.literal: He should urgently be given distinguished recognition.
translations.idiomatic: He should urgently be given distinguished recognition.

sentences.zh: 」乃命發湖廣軍前，以原品用。

translations.literal: " The emperor then ordered him dispatched to the Huguang front and employed at his original rank.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor then ordered him sent to the Huguang front and employed at his original rank.

sentences.zh: 會丁父憂，服闋，乃赴軍前。

translations.literal: It happened that he entered mourning for his father; after the mourning period ended he went to the front.
translations.idiomatic: He happened to enter mourning for his father. When the mourning period ended he went to the front.

sentences.zh: 總督蔡毓榮題補湖廣提學道，部議當以現辦軍務參議道題補。

translations.literal: Governor-General Cai Yurong nominated him to fill the Huguang educational intendant circuit; the ministries decided he should instead be nominated to the military affairs participation circuit currently being filled.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Cai Yurong nominated him to fill the Huguang educational intendant circuit. The ministries ruled that he should instead be nominated to the military affairs participation circuit then being filled.

sentences.zh: 康熙十七年，題補下荊南道。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year of Kangxi he was nominated and appointed to the Lower Jingnan circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year of Kangxi he was nominated and appointed to the Lower Jingnan circuit.

sentences.zh: 時襄陽總兵楊來嘉、副將洪福等叛應三桂。

translations.literal: At the time Xiangyang garrison commander Yang Laijia, deputy commander Hong Fu, and others rebelled in support of Wu Sangui.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Xiangyang garrison commander Yang Laijia, Deputy Commander Hong Fu, and others rebelled in support of Wu Sangui.

sentences.zh: 大軍運餉，自襄至房、保路險C7，舟車不通，歲調襄陽、安陸、德安三郡丁夫擔負，餉苦不繼。

translations.literal: The main army transported provisions from Xiangyang to Fang and Bao along dangerous routes where neither boats nor carts could pass; each year corvée laborers from the three prefectures of Xiangyang, Anlu, and De'an were conscripted to carry loads on their shoulders, and supplies were hard put to keep up.
translations.idiomatic: The main army had to transport provisions from Xiangyang to Fang and Bao along rugged routes where neither boats nor carts could pass. Each year corvée laborers from the three prefectures of Xiangyang, Anlu, and De'an were conscripted to carry loads on their shoulders, and supplies could barely keep up.

sentences.zh: 素蘊訪知穀城有小溪可通舟，乃按行山谷開餉道，由是水運通利，省丁夫什九，軍乃無乏。

translations.literal: Yang Suyun learned through inquiry that a small stream at Gucheng could be navigated by boat; he then surveyed the mountain valleys and opened a supply route, whereby water transport became convenient, corvée labor was reduced by nine tenths, and the army was no longer short.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Suyun learned that a small stream at Gucheng could be navigated by boat. He surveyed the mountain valleys and opened a supply route. Water transport became efficient, corvée labor was cut by nine tenths, and the army was no longer short of supplies.

sentences.zh: 遷山西提學道。

translations.literal: He was transferred to the Shanxi educational intendant circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to the Shanxi educational intendant circuit.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，任滿，薦舉擢通政司參議，累遷順天府尹。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, when his term expired, he was recommended and promoted to Participation Secretary in the Office of Transmission, then successively transferred to Intendant of Shuntian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year, when his term expired, he was recommended and promoted to participation secretary in the Office of Transmission, then rose in stages to intendant of Shuntian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，授安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year he was appointed Governor of Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year he was appointed governor of Anhui.

sentences.zh: 會歲饑，上疏請賑。

translations.literal: It happened that the year brought famine; he memorialized requesting relief.
translations.idiomatic: That year brought famine, and he memorialized requesting relief.

sentences.zh: 甫拜疏，即檄州縣開倉賑給，全活甚眾。

translations.literal: As soon as he had submitted the memorial he issued orders to the prefectures and counties to open the granaries and distribute relief, saving a great many lives.
translations.idiomatic: As soon as he had submitted the memorial he ordered the prefectures and counties to open the granaries and distribute relief, saving a great many lives.

sentences.zh: 尋調湖廣巡撫。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to Governor of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was transferred to governor of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 夏逢龍亂初定，脅從尚眾，人情恇擾，一夕數驚。

translations.literal: The rebellion of Xia Fenglong had just been pacified; those who had been compelled to follow were still numerous, popular sentiment was fearful and unsettled, and there were several alarms in a single night.
translations.idiomatic: The rebellion of Xia Fenglong had just been pacified. Those who had been compelled to follow were still numerous, the people were fearful and unsettled, and there were several alarms in a single night.

sentences.zh: 素蘊首嚴告訐之禁，反側以安。

translations.literal: Yang Suyun first strictly forbade malicious denunciation, and those who wavered were thereby pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Suyun first strictly forbade malicious denunciation, and those who wavered were pacified.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，大旱，疏請蠲免武昌等屬三十二州縣錢糧，上遣戶部郎中舒淑等會督撫勘災。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, during a great drought, he memorialized requesting exemption of taxes and grain levies in thirty-two prefectures and counties under Wuchang and elsewhere; the emperor dispatched Director Lang Shushu and others from the Ministry of Revenue to join the governor-general and governor in surveying the disaster.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year, during a great drought, he memorialized requesting exemption of taxes and grain levies in thirty-two prefectures and counties under Wuchang and elsewhere. The emperor dispatched Director Lang Shushu and others from the Ministry of Revenue to join the governor-general and governor in surveying the disaster.

sentences.zh: 舒淑至武昌，素蘊適患暑疾，令布政使於養志從總督丁思孔往勘。

translations.literal: When Shushu reached Wuchang, Yang Suyun happened to be ill from summer heat; he ordered Financial Commissioner Yu Yangzhi to accompany Governor Ding Sikong on the survey.
translations.idiomatic: When Shushu reached Wuchang, Yang Suyun happened to be ill from the summer heat. He ordered Financial Commissioner Yu Yangzhi to accompany Governor Ding Sikong on the survey.

sentences.zh: 尋稱病乞休，上疑其託疾，奪官。

translations.literal: Soon he claimed illness and requested retirement; the emperor suspected he was feigning sickness and stripped him of rank.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he claimed illness and requested retirement. The emperor suspected he was feigning sickness and stripped him of rank.

sentences.zh: 命甫下而素蘊已卒。

translations.literal: The order had just been issued when Yang Suyun had already died.
translations.idiomatic: The order had just been issued when Yang Suyun had already died.

sentences.zh: 先是，湖北郡縣疾苦最甚者，如沔陽、江陵、漢陽、嘉魚濱江地陷未蠲賦額，咸寧、黃陂、景陵谷折，江夏、崇陽、武昌、通城、漢陽、漢川、雲夢、孝感、應城穀田科重，監利一年兩賦，為民害數十年。

translations.literal: Earlier, among the most severe hardships in the prefectures and counties of Hubei were these: in Mianyang, Jiangling, Hanyang, and Jiayu, riverside land had subsided yet tax quotas had not been reduced; in Xianning, Huangpi, and Jingling grain yields were reduced by half; in Jiangxia, Chongyang, Wuchang, Tongcheng, Hanyang, Hanchuan, Yunmeng, Xiaogan, and Yingcheng grain-field taxes were heavy; in Jianli there were two levies in one year — abuses harming the people for decades.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, among the worst hardships in Hubei's prefectures and counties were these: in Mianyang, Jiangling, Hanyang, and Jiayu, riverside land had subsided yet tax quotas had not been reduced; in Xianning, Huangpi, and Jingling grain yields were cut in half; in Jiangxia, Chongyang, Wuchang, Tongcheng, Hanyang, Hanchuan, Yunmeng, Xiaogan, and Yingcheng grain-field taxes were oppressively heavy; in Jianli there were two levies in one year—abuses that had harmed the people for decades.

sentences.zh: 素蘊得其實，條為兩疏。

translations.literal: Yang Suyun obtained the facts and set them out in two memorials.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Suyun obtained the facts and set them out in two memorials.

sentences.zh: 未及上而病革，口授入遺疏，曰：「此疏行，吾目瞑矣！

translations.literal: Before he could submit them his illness became critical; he dictated them into a final memorial, saying, "If this memorial is implemented, I can close my eyes in peace!
translations.idiomatic: Before he could submit them his illness became critical. He dictated them into a final memorial, saying, "If this memorial is implemented, I can close my eyes in peace!

sentences.zh: 郭琇，字華野，山東即墨人。

translations.literal: Guo Xiu, courtesy name Huaye, was a native of Jimo in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Xiu, styled Huaye, was from Jimo in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 康熙九年進士。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination in the ninth year of Kangxi.
translations.idiomatic: He received his jinshi degree in the ninth year of Kangxi.

sentences.zh: 十八年，授江南吳江知縣。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he was appointed magistrate of Wujiang in Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year he was appointed magistrate of Wujiang in Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 材力強幹，善斷疑獄。

translations.literal: He was capable and forceful, skilled at deciding doubtful cases.
translations.idiomatic: He was capable and forceful and skilled at deciding difficult cases.

sentences.zh: 徵賦行版串法，胥吏不能為奸。

translations.literal: For tax collection he employed the plate-and-string method, so clerks and runners could not commit fraud.
translations.idiomatic: For tax collection he employed the plate-and-string method, so clerks and runners could not commit fraud.

sentences.zh: 居官七年，治行為江南最。

translations.literal: After seven years in office his administrative record was the finest in Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: After seven years in office his administrative record was the finest in Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，巡撫湯斌薦琇居心恬淡，蒞事精銳，請遷擢。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year Governor Tang Bin recommended Guo Xiu as calm in mind and sharp in handling affairs, requesting his promotion and transfer.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year Governor Tang Bin recommended Guo Xiu as calm in mind and sharp in handling affairs and asked that he be promoted.

sentences.zh: 部議以琇徵賦未如額，寢其奏，聖祖特許之，行取，授江南道御史。

translations.literal: The ministries deliberated that Guo Xiu's tax collection had not met quota and shelved the recommendation; the Sage Ancestor specially approved it, selected him for capital office, and appointed him censor of the Jiangnan circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The ministries ruled that Guo Xiu's tax collection had not met quota and shelved the recommendation. The Sage Ancestor specially approved it, selected him for service in the capital, and appointed him censor of the Jiangnan circuit.

sentences.zh: 時河督靳輔請停濬下河，築高家堰重堤，清丈堤外田畝以為屯田，謂可增歲收百餘萬。

translations.literal: At the time Grand Canal Director Jin Fu requested stopping dredging of the lower river, building heavy dikes at the Gaojia Weir, surveying fields outside the dikes for garrison farms, and claiming this could increase annual revenue by more than a million taels.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Grand Canal Director Jin Fu requested stopping dredging of the lower river, building heavy dikes at the Gaojia Weir, and surveying fields outside the dikes for garrison farms, claiming this could increase annual revenue by more than a million taels.

sentences.zh: 巡撫於成龍議不​​合，上令尚書佛倫往勘，主輔議。

translations.literal: Governor Yu Chenglong disagreed with the proposal; the emperor ordered Minister Folen to go and survey, and Folen upheld Jin Fu's plan.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Yu Chenglong disagreed with the proposal. The emperor ordered Minister Folen to go and survey, and Folen upheld Jin Fu's plan.

sentences.zh: 下九卿覈奏，尚書張玉書、左都御史徐乾學力言屯田擾民。

translations.literal: The matter was referred to the Nine Ministers for verification and memorial; Minister Zhang Yushu and Censor-in-Chief Xu Qianxue strongly argued that garrison farms would disturb the people.
translations.idiomatic: The matter was referred to the Nine Ministers for verification. Minister Zhang Yushu and Censor-in-Chief Xu Qianxue strongly argued that garrison farms would disturb the people.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，琇疏劾輔治河無功，偏聽幕客陳潢阻濬下河。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year Guo Xiu memorialized impeaching Jin Fu for achieving nothing in river control and blindly following his staff adviser Chen Huang in blocking dredging of the lower river.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year Guo Xiu memorialized impeaching Jin Fu for achieving nothing in river control and blindly following his staff adviser Chen Huang in blocking dredging of the lower river.

sentences.zh: 上御乾清門，召諸大臣，下琇疏，令會同察議。

translations.literal: The emperor held court at the Gate of Heavenly Purity, summoned the ministers, distributed Guo Xiu's memorial, and ordered joint investigation and deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor held court at the Gate of Heavenly Purity, summoned the ministers, distributed Guo Xiu's memorial, and ordered joint investigation and deliberation.

sentences.zh: 尋輔入覲，復召諸大臣與議。

translations.literal: Soon Jin Fu came to audience at court and the ministers were again summoned to deliberate with him.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Jin Fu came to audience at court and the ministers were again summoned to deliberate with him.

sentences.zh: 琇申言屯田害民，輔坐罷，而擢琇僉都御史。

translations.literal: Guo Xiu again stated that garrison farms harmed the people; Jin Fu was dismissed from office, and Guo Xiu was promoted to Assistant Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Xiu again argued that garrison farms harmed the people. Jin Fu was dismissed from office, and Guo Xiu was promoted to assistant censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 大學士明珠柄政，與餘國柱比，頗營賄賂，權傾一時，久之為上所覺。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Mingzhu held power in government, aligned himself with Yu Guozhu, and extensively traded in bribes; his authority dominated the age, until in time the emperor became aware of it.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Mingzhu held power in government, aligned himself with Yu Guozhu, and traded extensively in bribes. His authority dominated the age until the emperor became aware of it.

sentences.zh: 琇疏劾明珠與國柱結黨行私，詳列諸罪狀，並及佛倫、傅拉塔與輔等交通狀，於是明珠等降黜有差。

translations.literal: Guo Xiu memorialized impeaching Mingzhu and Guozhu for forming a faction and pursuing private interests, detailing their various crimes, and also citing Folen's, Fulate's, and Jin Fu's collusion; thereupon Mingzhu and the others were demoted to varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Xiu memorialized impeaching Mingzhu and Guozhu for forming a faction and pursuing private interests, detailing their various crimes, and also citing the collusion of Folen, Fulate, and Jin Fu. Mingzhu and the others were then demoted to varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 琇直聲震天下。

translations.literal: Guo Xiu's reputation for integrity shook the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Xiu's reputation for integrity shook the realm.

sentences.zh: 遷太常寺卿，再遷內閣學士。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, then again transferred to Grand Secretariat Academician.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, then again to grand secretariat academician.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，复遷吏部侍郎，充經筵講官，擢左都御史。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year he was again transferred to Vice Minister of Personnel, appointed lecturer at the Classics Colloquium, and promoted to Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year he was again transferred to vice minister of personnel, appointed lecturer at the Classics Colloquium, and promoted to left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 疏劾少詹事高士奇與原任左都御史王鴻緒植黨為奸，給事中何楷、修撰陳元龍、編修王頊齡依附壞法，士奇等並休致回籍。

translations.literal: He memorialized impeaching Junior Mentor Gao Shiqi and former Left Censor-in-Chief Wang Hongxu for forming a faction to do evil, and petitioning officials He Kai, Compiler Chen Yuanlong, and Editor Wang Xuling for attaching themselves and corrupting the law; Gao Shiqi and the others were all retired and sent home.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized impeaching Junior Mentor Gao Shiqi and former Left Censor-in-Chief Wang Hongxu for forming a faction to do evil, and petitioning officials He Kai, Compiler Chen Yuanlong, and Editor Wang Xuling for attaching themselves and corrupting the law. Gao Shiqi and the others were all retired and sent home.

sentences.zh: 未幾，御史張星法劾山東巡撫錢鎯貪黷，鎯奏辨，因及琇嘗致書囑薦即墨知縣高上達等，卻之，遂挾嫌使星法誣劾，下法司訊。

translations.literal: Before long Censor Zhang Xingfa impeached Shandong Governor Qian Heng for greed and corruption; Qian memorialized in rebuttal, citing that Guo Xiu had once written urging recommendation of Jimo Magistrate Gao Shangda and others, which he had refused, and therefore bore a grudge and incited Zhang Xingfa to impeach falsely; the case was referred to the judicial offices for investigation.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Censor Zhang Xingfa impeached Shandong Governor Qian Heng for greed and corruption. Qian memorialized in rebuttal, claiming that Guo Xiu had once written urging recommendation of Jimo Magistrate Gao Shangda and others, which he had refused, and therefore bore a grudge and incited Zhang Xingfa to impeach falsely. The case was referred to the judicial offices for investigation.

sentences.zh: 獄未具，琇疏言：「左都御​​史馬齊於會訊時多方鍛鍊，必欲實以指使誣劾罪。

translations.literal: Before the case was concluded Guo Xiu memorialized, saying, "Left Censor-in-Chief Ma Qi during the joint inquiry repeatedly forged evidence, determined to establish the charge of directing a false impeachment.
translations.idiomatic: Before the case was concluded Guo Xiu memorialized: "Left Censor-in-Chief Ma Qi, during the joint inquiry, repeatedly forged evidence, determined to establish the charge of directing a false impeachment.

sentences.zh: 」詔責琇疑揣。

translations.literal: " An edict rebuked Guo Xiu for suspicion and presumption.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict rebuked Guo Xiu for suspicion and presumption.

sentences.zh: 尋法司奏琇請託事實，當奪官。

translations.literal: Soon the judicial offices memorialized that the facts of Guo Xiu's solicitation were established and he should be stripped of rank.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the judicial offices memorialized that the facts of Guo Xiu's solicitation were established and he should be stripped of rank.

sentences.zh: 上以琇平日鯁直敢言，改降五級調用。

translations.literal: The emperor, considering Guo Xiu's usual blunt integrity and willingness to speak out, instead reduced him five ranks and transferred him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, considering Guo Xiu's usual blunt integrity and willingness to speak out, instead reduced him five ranks and transferred him.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，吏部推琇通政司參議，上命改令予琇休致。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year the Ministry of Personnel recommended Guo Xiu as Participation Secretary in the Office of Transmission; the emperor ordered instead that Guo Xiu be granted retirement.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year the Ministry of Personnel recommended Guo Xiu as participation secretary in the Office of Transmission. The emperor ordered instead that Guo Xiu be granted retirement.

sentences.zh: 江寧巡撫洪之傑以吳江縣虧漕項，事涉琇，牒山東追琇赴質。

translations.literal: Jiangning Governor Hong Zhijie, citing a deficit in grain transport funds in Wujiang County involving Guo Xiu, dispatched a warrant to Shandong summoning Guo Xiu to answer the charges.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangning Governor Hong Zhijie, citing a deficit in grain transport funds in Wujiang County involving Guo Xiu, dispatched a warrant to Shandong summoning Guo Xiu to answer the charges.

sentences.zh: 時佛倫為山東巡撫，因劾琇違例逗留希進用，請奪官逮治；

translations.literal: At the time Folen was Governor of Shandong; he thereupon impeached Guo Xiu for unlawfully lingering in hope of reappointment and requested stripping his rank and arresting him for punishment;
translations.idiomatic: At the time Folen was governor of Shandong. He thereupon impeached Guo Xiu for unlawfully lingering in hope of reappointment and requested stripping his rank and arresting him for punishment;

sentences.zh: 又劾琇世父郭爾印乃明季御史黃宗昌家奴，琇父郭景昌原名爾標，嘗入賊黨伏法，琇私改父名請誥封，應追奪。

translations.literal: He also impeached Guo Xiu on the grounds that his father's elder brother Guo Eryin had been a household slave of the late-Ming censor Huang Zongchang; Guo Xiu's father Guo Jingchang had originally been named Erbiao, had once joined bandit factions and been executed by law; Guo Xiu had privately changed his father's name to obtain an edict of ennoblement, which should be revoked.
translations.idiomatic: He also impeached Guo Xiu on the grounds that his father's elder brother Guo Eryin had been a household slave of the late-Ming censor Huang Zongchang; that Guo Xiu's father Guo Jingchang had originally been named Erbiao, had once joined bandit factions and been executed by law; and that Guo Xiu had privately changed his father's name to obtain an edict of ennoblement, which should be revoked.

sentences.zh: 部議如所請，逮赴江寧勘治。

translations.literal: The ministries agreed as requested and ordered his arrest and transfer to Jiangning for investigation and punishment.
translations.idiomatic: The ministries agreed as requested and ordered his arrest and transfer to Jiangning for investigation and punishment.

sentences.zh: 坐侵收運船飯米二千三百餘石，事發彌補，議遣戍，詔寬之。

translations.literal: He was found guilty of unlawfully collecting more than twenty-three hundred shi of rice for transport boats' provisions; when the matter came to light he made restitution; exile was recommended, but an edict granted leniency.
translations.idiomatic: He was found guilty of unlawfully collecting more than twenty-three hundred shi of rice meant for transport boats' provisions. When the matter came to light he made restitution. Exile was recommended, but an edict granted leniency.

sentences.zh: 三十八年，上南巡，琇迎駕德州。

translations.literal: In the thirty-eighth year, during the emperor's southern tour, Guo Xiu welcomed the imperial procession at Dezhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-eighth year, during the emperor's southern tour, Guo Xiu welcomed the imperial procession at Dezhou.

sentences.zh: 既還京師，諭大學士阿蘭泰等曰：「原任左都御史郭琇，前為吳江令，居官甚善，百姓感頌至今。

translations.literal: After returning to the capital he instructed Grand Secretary Alantai and others, saying, "Former Left Censor-in-Chief Guo Xiu, previously magistrate of Wujiang, served very well in office, and the people praise him to this day.
translations.idiomatic: After returning to the capital he instructed Grand Secretary Alantai and others: "Former Left Censor-in-Chief Guo Xiu, previously magistrate of Wujiang, served very well in office, and the people praise him to this day.

sentences.zh: 其人有膽量，可授湖廣總督，令馳驛赴任。

translations.literal: This man has courage and capacity; he may be appointed Governor-General of Huguang and ordered to proceed post-haste to his post.
translations.idiomatic: This man has courage and capacity. He may be appointed governor-general of Huguang and ordered to proceed post-haste to his post.

sentences.zh: 」琇上官，疏言：「黃州、武昌二府兵米二萬七千有奇，運給荊州、鄖陽汛地，懸隔千里，輓輸費不貲，請改折色。

translations.literal: " When Guo Xiu assumed office he memorialized, saying, "The two prefectures of Huangzhou and Wuchang supply more than twenty-seven thousand shi of military grain, transported to garrison posts at Jingzhou and Xunyang a thousand li distant; transport costs are incalculable — I request conversion to cash payment.
translations.idiomatic: " When Guo Xiu assumed office he memorialized: "The two prefectures of Huangzhou and Wuchang supply more than twenty-seven thousand shi of military grain, transported to garrison posts at Jingzhou and Xunyang a thousand li distant. Transport costs are incalculable. I request conversion to cash payment.

sentences.zh: 江夏等十三州縣有故明籓產，田瘠賦重，數倍民糧，請一律減徵。

translations.literal: In thirteen prefectures and counties including Jiangxia there are estates of the former Ming princes; the land is poor yet taxes are heavy, several times ordinary civilian grain levies — I request uniform reduction.
translations.idiomatic: In thirteen prefectures and counties including Jiangxia there are estates of the former Ming princes. The land is poor yet taxes are heavy, several times ordinary civilian grain levies. I request uniform reduction.

sentences.zh: 江夏、嘉魚、漢陽三縣瀕江地，水齧土陊，有賦無田者三百餘頃，請豁免。

translations.literal: In the three counties of Jiangxia, Jiayu, and Hanyang, riverside land eroded by water has collapsed; more than three hundred qing have tax obligations but no fields — I request exemption.
translations.idiomatic: In the three counties of Jiangxia, Jiayu, and Hanyang, riverside land eroded by water has collapsed. More than three hundred qing have tax obligations but no fields. I request exemption.

sentences.zh: 」皆允行。

translations.literal: " All were approved for implementation.
translations.idiomatic: " All were approved.

sentences.zh: 三十九年，入覲，因奏言：「臣父景昌，即墨縣諸生，有冊可稽。

translations.literal: In the thirty-ninth year he came to audience and memorialized, saying, "My father Jingchang was a licentiate of Jimo County; records exist for verification.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-ninth year he came to audience and memorialized: "My father Jingchang was a licentiate of Jimo County. Records exist for verification.

sentences.zh: 邑匪郭爾標本無妻室，安得有子？

translations.literal: The man of this county named Guo Erbiao originally had no wife — how could he have had a son?
translations.idiomatic: The man of this county named Guo Erbiao originally had no wife. How could he have had a son?

sentences.zh: 不知佛倫何所據，誣臣並及臣父。

translations.literal: I do not know on what grounds Folen falsely accused me and implicated my father as well.
translations.idiomatic: I do not know on what grounds Folen falsely accused me and implicated my father as well.

sentences.zh: 」時佛倫為大學士，上詰之，以舛錯對，命仍予誥軸。

translations.literal: " At the time Folen was Grand Secretary; the emperor questioned him, and he answered with errors; the emperor ordered that the patent of honor still be granted.
translations.idiomatic: " At the time Folen was grand secretary. The emperor questioned him, and he answered with errors. The emperor ordered that the patent of honor still be granted.

sentences.zh: 琇陛辭，奏請清丈地畝，並言湖南地廣人稀，恐清丈後賦當差減。

translations.literal: At his audience of leave Guo Xiu memorialized requesting a comprehensive land survey, and stated that Hunan was broad in territory and sparse in population, fearing that after the survey taxes would need to be reduced accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: At his audience of leave Guo Xiu memorialized requesting a comprehensive land survey, and stated that Hunan was broad in territory and sparse in population, fearing that after the survey taxes would need to be reduced accordingly.

sentences.zh: 上問：「當減幾何？

translations.literal: The emperor asked, "By how much should they be reduced?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor asked, "By how much should they be reduced?

sentences.zh: 」琇言：「當減十分之三。

translations.literal: " Guo Xiu said, "They should be reduced by three tenths.
translations.idiomatic: " Guo Xiu said, "They should be reduced by three tenths.

sentences.zh: 」上曰：「果益民，雖倍於此，亦不惜也！

translations.literal: " The emperor said, "If it truly benefits the people, even double that amount would not be spared!
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor said, "If it truly benefits the people, even double that amount would not be spared!

sentences.zh: 」尋條陳三事：一，嚴定築堤處分；

translations.literal: " Soon he itemized three matters: first, strictly fixing penalties for dike construction;
translations.idiomatic: " Soon he itemized three matters: first, strictly fixing penalties for dike construction;

sentences.zh: 一，停造無用糧船；

translations.literal: second, stopping construction of useless grain transport boats;
translations.idiomatic: second, stopping construction of useless grain transport boats;

sentences.zh: 一，通融調補苗疆官吏。

translations.literal: third, flexibly transferring and filling Miao frontier official posts.
translations.idiomatic: third, flexibly transferring and filling Miao frontier official posts.

sentences.zh: 又疏禁徵賦諸弊政。

translations.literal: He also memorialized forbidding various abusive practices in tax collection.
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized forbidding various abusive practices in tax collection.

sentences.zh: 上嘉其實心除弊，並允行。

translations.literal: The emperor praised his sincere effort to eliminate abuses and approved all for implementation.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised his sincere effort to eliminate abuses and approved all for implementation.

sentences.zh: 時紅苗就撫，琇陳善後之策，請頒詔敕，令勒石永遵。

translations.literal: At the time the Red Miao had submitted to pacification; Guo Xiu set out policies for subsequent order, requesting issuance of an edict and command to be carved in stone for perpetual observance.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the Red Miao had submitted to pacification. Guo Xiu set out policies for subsequent order, requesting issuance of an edict and command to be carved in stone for perpetual observance.

sentences.zh: 四十年，以病乞休，上曰：「琇病甚，思一人代之不可得，能如琇者有幾人耶？

translations.literal: In the fortieth year he requested retirement on grounds of illness; the emperor said, "Guo Xiu is very ill; I think of finding someone to replace him and cannot; how many men are there like Guo Xiu?
translations.idiomatic: In the fortieth year he requested retirement on grounds of illness. The emperor said, "Guo Xiu is very ill. I think of finding someone to replace him and cannot. How many men are there like Guo Xiu?

sentences.zh: 」給事中馬士芳劾湖廣布政使任風厚久病，巡撫年遐齡徇庇不以聞。

translations.literal: " Petitioning official Ma Shifang impeached Huguang Financial Commissioner Ren Fenghou for long illness, and Governor Nian Xialing for shielding him and not reporting it.
translations.idiomatic: " Petitioning official Ma Shifang impeached Huguang Financial Commissioner Ren Fenghou for long illness, and Governor Nian Xialing for shielding him and not reporting it.

sentences.zh: 遐齡奏風厚實無病。

translations.literal: Xialing memorialized that Fenghou was in fact not ill.
translations.idiomatic: Xialing memorialized that Fenghou was in fact not ill.

sentences.zh: 風厚入覲，上見其未衰，因曰：「任風厚若不堪任使，郭琇豈肯徇庇耶？

translations.literal: Fenghou came to audience; the emperor saw he was not yet enfeebled and therefore said, "If Ren Fenghou were unfit for service, would Guo Xiu have been willing to shield him?
translations.idiomatic: Fenghou came to audience. The emperor saw he was not yet enfeebled and therefore said, "If Ren Fenghou were unfit for service, would Guo Xiu have been willing to shield him?

sentences.zh: 」未幾，琇以病劇再疏求罷，仍慰留。

translations.literal: " Before long Guo Xiu, his illness severe, again memorialized requesting dismissal, but was still comforted and retained.
translations.idiomatic: " Before long Guo Xiu, his illness severe, again memorialized requesting dismissal, but was still comforted and retained.

sentences.zh: 黃梅知縣李錦催科不力，琇委員摘印。

translations.literal: Huangmei Magistrate Li Jin was ineffective in tax collection; Guo Xiu dispatched an official to remove his seal of office.
translations.idiomatic: Huangmei Magistrate Li Jin was ineffective in tax collection. Guo Xiu dispatched an official to remove his seal of office.

sentences.zh: 錦得民心，民閉城拒之，乞留錦。

translations.literal: Li Jin had won the people's hearts; the people closed the city gates to resist and begged that Li Jin be kept.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jin had won the people's hearts. The people closed the city gates to resist and begged that Li Jin be kept.

sentences.zh: 御史左必蕃劾琇，部議當奪官，上以清丈未畢，緩之。

translations.literal: Censor Zuo Bifan impeached Guo Xiu; the ministries recommended stripping his rank; the emperor, because the land survey was not yet complete, deferred action.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Zuo Bifan impeached Guo Xiu. The ministries recommended stripping his rank. The emperor, because the land survey was not yet complete, deferred action.

sentences.zh: 四十一年，鎮筸諸生李定等叩閽奏紅苗殺掠，總督、巡撫匿不以聞；

translations.literal: In the forty-first year students Li Ding and others from Zhenqian petitioned at the palace gate reporting Red Miao killings and plunder; the governor-general and governor concealed it and did not report it;
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-first year students Li Ding and others from Zhenqian petitioned at the palace gate reporting Red Miao killings and plunder. The governor-general and governor concealed it and did not report it;

sentences.zh: 而給事中宋駿業亦劾琇向騖虛聲，近益衰廢，持祿養癰。

translations.literal: Meanwhile petitioning official Song Junye also impeached Guo Xiu for formerly pursuing empty reputation, recently growing ever more enfeebled and negligent, and holding his stipend while nursing an abscess.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile petitioning official Song Junye also impeached Guo Xiu for formerly pursuing empty reputation, recently growing ever more enfeebled and negligent, and holding his stipend while nursing an abscess.

sentences.zh: 乃命侍郎傅繼祖、甘國樞，浙江巡撫趙申喬往按。

translations.literal: The emperor then ordered Vice Ministers Fu Jizu and Gan Guoshu and Zhejiang Governor Zhao Shenqiao to go and investigate.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then ordered Vice Ministers Fu Jizu and Gan Guoshu and Zhejiang Governor Zhao Shenqiao to go and investigate.

sentences.zh: 會琇報清丈畢，乞罷任。

translations.literal: It happened that Guo Xiu reported the land survey complete and requested dismissal from office.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that Guo Xiu reported the land survey complete and requested dismissal from office.

sentences.zh: 上責其清丈稽延，與前奏不合，行不顧言；

translations.literal: The emperor rebuked him for delaying the land survey, inconsistent with his earlier memorial, acting without regard for his words;
translations.idiomatic: The emperor rebuked him for delaying the land survey, inconsistent with his earlier memorial, acting without regard for his words;

sentences.zh: 並及匿報紅苗殺掠與黃梅拒命事。

translations.literal: and also cited concealing reports of Red Miao killings and plunder and the Huangmei defiance of orders.
translations.idiomatic: and also cited concealing reports of Red Miao killings and plunder and the Huangmei defiance of orders.

sentences.zh: 琇自陳老病失察，請治罪。

translations.literal: Guo Xiu himself stated that old age and illness had caused his failure of oversight and requested punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Xiu himself stated that old age and illness had caused his failure of oversight and requested punishment.
